title: Paxton Outdoor Barrel Sauna with Porch – 4-6 Person
current_description:
The largest sauna in the Paxton line puts a covered porch on the front of the biggest barrel. Two full-length linear benches inside seat up to six at the same heat level, and the porch seating gives the group a spot to rest between rounds and stow their gear.
Cedar tongue-and-groove walls, an 8mm tempered glass door, and a powder-coated galvanized steel roof make up the shell. The PrairieFire™ 9kW electric heater preheats around 50% faster than a standard 6kW model, and the heater, stones, Wi-Fi control panel, bucket, ladle, LED lighting, and hooks all come with it. Assembly follows the BILT® app step by step, and every component is covered by a 5-year warranty backed by support seven days a week.

title: Rylan Indoor Infrared Sauna – 1 Person
current_description:
Eight low-EMF far infrared carbon panels surround the single seat in this cabin, one of them under the floor, so the heat arrives from every direction without shifting around to find it. They reach your set temperature roughly 20% faster than standard panels, and the bench is cut extra deep so there is room to settle in.
It runs off a standard 120V household outlet, which means no electrician and no new circuit. Red light therapy, chromotherapy, Bluetooth speakers, and the controls are included. Cedar panels are 33% thicker than standard with double-wall construction and an 8mm tempered glass door, and they arrive pre-built, pre-drilled, pre-stained, and pre-wired. Every component carries a five-year warranty with support seven days a week.

title: Beach Front Swing Set
current_description: Monkey bars, an 8-foot wave slide, and a large upper deck under a colorful canopy. A ship's steering wheel and a toy telescope are mounted within reach on the deck. Kids climb the rock wall, which doubles as the ladder, then cross the monkey bars or take the slide down. Two belt swings and a trapeze hang from the beam. At ground level, the shaded area under the deck works as a sandbox, with sand not included, and a covered snack bar window with bench seating and a bright awning gives kids somewhere to sit with a drink or spread out craft supplies. The frame is cedar, which naturally resists rot and decay. It ships ready to assemble with interactive step-by-step instructions in the BILT app and a 5-year warranty.
current_excerpt: Cedar playset with monkey bars, an 8-foot wave slide, a canopy-covered deck with ship's wheel and telescope, and a snack bar window with bench seating.
source_facts:
The Beach Front Swing Set lets your kids’ imaginations run wild. This wooden swing set features a large upper play deck with a colorful canopy, where children can imagine sailing the high seas in search of pirates with the included steering wheel and toy telescope. Kids can adventure up the rock wall that doubles as a ladder for a playful route to the deck, while the monkey bars offer fun climbing challenges. The 8-foot speedy slide offers a quick and exhilarating ride back to ground level, ensuring smiles and laughter with every ride. Below, a fun sandbox area invites children to engage in creative sensory play by building sandcastles and practicing writing their names. When it's time for a break, kids can go to the snack bar, complete with a built-in bench and brightly colored awning that’s perfect for enjoying a cool drink or a snack. Crafted from durable cedar wood, this swing set playground naturally resists rot and decay, ensuring years of outdoor fun. This backyard swing set is ready to assemble and the BILT® app provides interactive, step-by-step instructions for added convenience. The Beach Front Swing Set encourages physical activity, sparks imagination, and creates an unforgettable backyard playground.
 

• Elevated Adventure: Raised play deck with a colorful canopy roof, ship's wheel, and toy telescope is perfect for outdoor play 

• Lower Play Space: Shaded sandbox area to inspire creative sensory play (sand not included) 

• Industry-Leading Warranty: 5-year warranty for added peace of mind 

• Monkey Bar Fun: Creates a playful challenge that promotes strength as children swing and climb 

• Built-In Picnic Area: Covered snack bar window with bench seating is ideal for juice breaks or arts and crafts 

• Versatile Swinging Fun: 2 classic belt swings and 1 trapeze allow multiple kids to swing at once 

• Speedy Wave Slide: 8-foot wave slide offers swift, safe descents for endless fun every time

title: Big Brutus Heavy-Duty Metal A-Frame Swing Set
current_description: Entirely steel: galvanized steel under a powder-coated finish, with no wood to stain or seal. The angled A-frame is what gives it stability, and the heavy-duty hardware is sized to match. Two belt swings hang on coated chains that stay comfortable to grip, with a metal trapeze bar beside them for hanging and flipping. The swing zone is extra large, leaving room for more than one child to swing at the same time without crowding. Molded feet and the included ground anchors hold the frame down as a freestanding structure. Pieces come pre-fabricated, pre-drilled, and powder coated for assembly, and the set carries a 5-year warranty. Galvanized steel also means weather does little to it and upkeep stays minimal.
current_excerpt: Heavy-duty galvanized steel A-frame swing set with two coated-chain belt swings, a metal trapeze, molded feet with ground anchors, and a 5-year warranty.
source_facts:
Create lasting memories with the Big Brutus Galvanized Steel Swing Set from Backyard Discovery. Standing nearly 10-feet-tall, this heavy-duty outdoor swing set redefines durability and play for little ones. Engineered with robust, powder-coated steel, the Big Brutus offers unparalleled strength for lasting outdoor fun and memories. Its heavy-duty A-frame construction provides exceptional stability, ensuring a safe and thrilling play experience for children. Two durable belt swings and a metal trapeze bar invite endless active play, allowing kids to soar, swing, and practice their acrobatic skills. Plus, the swing chains feature a smooth coating for added convenience and a comfy grip. Designed for maximum durability, this metal swing set stands up to harsh weather conditions. It's crafted from premium galvanized steel to ensure long-lasting performance while making maintenance a breeze. Molded feet with included anchors provide rock-solid stability, while heavy-duty hardware promises years of reliable use, giving parents peace of mind while children explore and play. With a ready-to-assemble design, this backyard swing set kit offers a simple setup and is backed by a 5-year warranty. Built to withstand years of active play, the Big Brutus Swing Set provides a dependable outdoor play experience that keeps kids moving and having fun.
 

• Traditional A-Frame Design: Angled A-frame made from heavy-duty powder-coated galvanized steel for exceptional strength and stability

title: Bristol Point Swing Set
current_description: Two slides run off the clubhouse here, an enclosed spiral tube slide and a 10-foot wave slide. The clubhouse sits under a wooden roof with bay windows that bring in natural light, two balconies, a steering wheel, a chalkboard, and a toy telescope for scouting the yard. Getting up is either the flat-step ladder or the rock wall, which has twelve holds. The level below is a playhouse with a working half door, a mounted chalkboard, and a play kitchen holding a toy stovetop, a grill, a sink, a battery-powered blender, plastic food, a cookware set, and a dinner bell. Two belt swings and a trapeze hang from the beam. The frame is natural cedar, it ships ready to assemble with BILT app instructions, and a 5-year warranty comes with it.
current_excerpt: Cedar playset with a spiral tube slide and a 10-foot wave slide, a two-balcony clubhouse, a twelve-hold rock wall, and a lower-level play kitchen.
source_facts:
The fun never stops with the Bristol Point Swing Set by Backyard Discovery. This outdoor playset is designed with exciting play features that transform your backyard into an ultimate playground adventure. The charming clubhouse boasts inviting bay windows that flood the space with natural light, a wooden roof, two balconies, a playful steering wheel, and a chalkboard that's perfect for creative drawing. Kids can peek through the toy telescope to scout their next mission before zooming down the spiral tube slide or racing down the 10-foot speedy wave slide. Little climbers will love scaling the rock wall with 12 climbing holds, while the flat step ladder provides easy accessibility to reach the clubhouse. The lower play space offers even more imaginative fun with an adorable half door and mounted chalkboard. Inside, a charming play kitchen comes alive with a toy sink, grill, and cookware set, allowing kids to whip up pretend meals and ring the dinner bell when it's time to eat. Outdoor playtime continues with two classic belt swings and a trapeze for active fun. Crafted from natural cedar, this wooden swing set is built to last while the ready-to-assemble design and BILT® app instructions make setup a breeze.
 

• Elevated Adventure: Spacious raised clubhouse with a wooden roof, bay windows two balconies, chalkboard, toy telescope, and steering wheel is perfect for outdoor play 

• Lower Playhouse: Includes a play kitchen with a toy stovetop, grill, sink, battery powered blender, plastic food, cookware set, and dinner bell to inspire creativity 

• Industry-Leading Warranty: 5-year warranty for added peace of mind 

• Spiral Tube Slide: Enclosed curvy slide delivers exhilarating, twisty rides for little adventurers 

• Chalkboard Door: Adorable working half door with a built-in chalkboard is ready for artwork and cute messages 

• Versatile Swinging Fun: 2 classic belt swings and 1 trapeze allow multiple kids to swing at once 

• Speedy Wave Slide: 10-foot wave slide offers swift, safe descents for endless fun every time

title: Lakewood Swing Set
current_description:
Backyard Discovery designed the Lakewood for yards that cannot take a sprawling playset. An elevated clubhouse with a colorful canopy roof and a window sits above a lower playhouse, and that ground floor has a full front door, a snack bar window, and built-in bench seating, which is enough to turn it into a cafe for whatever game is running that afternoon.
A wide rung flat step ladder makes the climb manageable for a range of ages, and the 8-foot wave slide handles the trip back down. Two classic belt swings and a trapeze bar let several kids swing at once, and the canopy adds shade without blocking your view of them.
The frame is cedar, which resists decay on its own outdoors. Assembly is guided step by step in the BILT app, and the set carries a 5-year warranty.
current_excerpt: Backyard Discovery built this cedar playset for smaller yards, with an elevated clubhouse, a lower playhouse, an 8-foot wave slide, and three swinging spots.
source_facts:
